description: How a campaign did: sent, delivered, bounced, complained, unique opens and clicks, and open_rate and click_rate over delivered (null until something is delivered). Opens and clicks count only people: a security gateway that followed every link, or a mailbox that loaded every image on arrival, is left out, and automated_opened and automated_clicked say how many recipients that removed. Report opened and clicked as the campaign's results; adding the automated figures back gives the inflated number other tools show, not more readers. Apple Mail's privacy prefetch cannot be told from a read and is in opened, so open_rate overstates and click_rate is the better signal. get_broadcast has progress and A/B results, not these totals. An unknown id answers 404 not_found.

id.description: The campaign's id from create_broadcast or list_broadcasts (a UUID), not its name

name: get_broadcast_metrics
